   --  Version of the OpenAPI document this SDK was generated from.

   --  Version of this SDK.
   SDK_Version : constant String := "0.6.0";

   --  Production base URL.
   Default_Base_URL : constant String := "https://api.test";

   --  Number of scopes the security scheme defines.
   Scope_Count : constant := 3;

   type Scope_Index is range 1 .. Scope_Count;
   type Scope_Names is array (Scope_Index) of access constant String;

   Scope_1 : aliased constant String := "agents:read";
   Scope_2 : aliased constant String := "agents:write";
   Scope_3 : aliased constant String := "billing:read";

   --  Every scope named by the UARP security scheme.
   Scopes : constant Scope_Names :=
      (Scope_1'Access,
    Scope_2'Access,
    Scope_3'Access);

end UARP.Meta;
